photos.title: Cherry Grove, North Myrtle Beach, from a height, 2012
photos.what: Looking north-east up Ocean Boulevard in Cherry Grove from a height: the wide beach and the ocean on the right, Cherry Grove Pier reaching into the ocean, a row of older low beach houses and motels beside mid-rise condo buildings, and the marsh and its channels behind them on the left. A few store signs are small and at the edge; no person is the subject.
photos.caption: Cherry Grove from a height: older low beach houses beside mid-rise condos, the marsh behind them, and Cherry Grove Pier.
photos.alt: Looking up the beach in Cherry Grove from a height: low beach houses and mid-rise condo buildings along the road, the marsh behind them, and a long fishing pier reaching into the ocean

place.sublocation: Cherry Grove, Ocean Boulevard and Cherry Grove Pier

photos.provenance: Wikimedia Commons, File:Cherry_Grove_Pier.jpg (4320 x 3240), downloaded 2026-11-03 at 1920 x 1440 through Special:FilePath.
photos.subject_check: Looked at full size (1920 px) by the writer of /submarkets/north-myrtle-beach/ on 2026-11-03: the pier, the beach, low houses beside mid-rise condos and the marsh behind them are all clear. Taken in 2012, before Hurricane Ian; the caption does not describe today's buildings one by one.

photos.title: The pavilion at Ocean Drive Beach, postcard, 1941
photos.what: A colored 1941 postcard titled 'Pavilion, Ocean Drive Beach, S. C.': a long two-story wooden pavilion on the sand with 'Roberts Pavilion' and 'Dancing' painted on its end wall, a bath house and cafe signs along its front, and two cars of the time parked beside it. Drink advertisements on the wall are incidental, not the subject; no person is the subject.
